```
['compile a cBench benchmark source directory into an unoptimized LLVM bitcode file', 'run the CLI tool to compile cBench sources to LLVM bitcode with custom cflags', 'create an LLVM bitcode module from C source files in a benchmark directory', 'review the make_cbench_llvm_module function that compiles C sources into LLVM bitcode', 'summarize the make_llvm_module script that compiles cBench benchmarks to LLVM bitcode']

```
